Callout.Name: Row of Cars on Fire
Callout.Message: Several vehicles alight in a car park.
Callout.Advisory: Four or five vehicles, no persons at risk.

Script.Line: One went up and then it was two, and then it was all of them.
They are parked nose to tail. That is the whole problem.
People are still trying to drive out. Somebody needs to stop them.

Lines.Approach: Four or five of them and it is moving down the row. Water and distance.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
